Privacy policy

Updated: 23 November 2026

Short version

This website has no accounts, no sign-up forms, no advertising and no tracking cookies. We do not sell or share personal data.

What is collected

Like every website, our hosting provider (Cloudflare) processes technical data such as your IP address and browser type to deliver pages and protect the site from abuse. We do not use this data to identify you.

Copy buttons

The copy buttons put a prompt on your device's clipboard. Nothing you copy is sent to us.

The Zehn app

Links to the App Store, Google Play and thezehnapp.com take you to other services with their own privacy policies. If you use the Zehn app, its own privacy policy applies to the app.

Your rights and contact

If you have a question about privacy, write to contact@safarigrp.com. Intellect AI is a project of Safari Group, Dubai.
